headline: Sikko Industries signs three-year organic fertilizer supply MoU with Uganda
summary: Sikko Industries Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding to supply organic fertilizers for three years to Operation Wealth Creation, a presidential initiative of the Ugandan government. This international supply deal opens up export avenues for the company's agricultural products. Retail investors can view this as an expansion of the company's international footprint in the African market. However, execution details and financial value were not disclosed in the filing.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings reflecting export revenue contributions
why_it_matters: Export expansion opens new revenue channels for the micro-cap fertilizer maker.

headline: Sikko Industries submits Q2 FY2026 dematerialisation compliance report
hook: Routine regulatory filing for Sikko Industries
summary: Sikko Industries has filed its mandatory dematerialisation compliance certificate with SEBI for the second quarter of the 2026 fiscal year. This filing confirms the company's adherence to regulatory standards regarding the electronic holding of securities. Such filings are a standard procedural requirement for all listed entities in India. It provides no change to the company's financial outlook or operational status.
